data_fields.name: turnLimit
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 = no limit (default); fires when turn > limit

data_fields.name: chronoTrigger
data_fields.donor_constant: FORCE_LOSE default; enum FORCE_LOSE=0, FORCE_ABORT=1, FORCE_WIN=2

data_fields.name: stageGateMinCount
data_fields.donor_constant: any positive count (exit-tile party or survivors) and a named nextStage

data_fields.name: abortCarryTile
data_fields.donor_constant: party member must stand on END_POINT to carry when aborted

data_fields.name: despawnPenalty
data_fields.donor_constant: 1000 on STR_CARGO_SHIP_P1 (2000 on another mission, grep only)

data_fields.name: spawnPriorityZeroIsNoSpawn
data_fields.donor_constant: priority 0 = not a spawn; highest priority wins; ties random

best_idea: Treat a multi-stage instance as a hand-off with explicit carry rules (who stays, what drops, what goes to the next stage) read from zone data, rather than rebuilding the zone from scratch.
decision_why: Keep the stage chain in zone data, the exit-tile gate, abort keeps only exit-tile members and the three-bucket loot outcome; run it on the server into the one ledger. Reject the X-COM ammo, research-gate and craft-inventory specifics (not in our rulings). Fix the donor defects D1 (unplaced soldier counted live), D2 (abort not a data field), D3 (unconscious carry implicit), D4 (units never erased).
acceptance: A server test: a 2-stage zone run aborted with 2 of 4 party members on the exit tile loads stage 2 with exactly those 2 alive members placed on spawn nodes, the other 2 flagged out, and no unplaced party member counted live in the next tick.
